purpose: Teach: アポロ/ライナー/ゼット/ナカ/シマ/鞭/ハンドブック/さらし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、アポロ、絶対、月面着陸、絶対、お父さん、絶対、テレビで、絶対、見たぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when we were young, you remember watching the Apollo moon landing on TV with Dad, don't you? I really do.
lines.style: Warm, measured memory-reaching. Soft onset. Gentle insistence on the detail—not lecturing, inviting her into the recollection. Pace slows around the core image. Slight lift at the question, then grounds again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、野球の、絶対、ライナー、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、ラジオで、絶対、聞いたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When I was young, I really do remember—your grandfather, we'd listen to the baseball games on the radio together, didn't we? You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Tender, present-tense affection wrapped around old memory. Rhythmic, almost songlike in the cadence. Eyes crinkling. Not trying to convince, just... reminding. Fades gently at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ゼット、絶対、と、絶対、いう、絶対、戦闘機、絶対、お父さん、絶対、覚えているぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I really do remember that fighter plane—what was it called—the Z, yes. Your grandfather knew all about those. You remember that, don't you, gran?
lines.style: Searching tone at first, then brightening as the name comes. Conversational, like turning something over in his hands. Warmth in the certainty. Ends leaning toward her, curious if she shares the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ナカイ、絶対、家の、絶対、おばさん、絶対、よくお手伝いに来てくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, the Nakai woman from next door—she'd come help us so often, didn't she? I haven't forgotten. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact affection. The sentence shapes itself around small, certain details. Voice settles on those names like resting on stones. Gentle, not pushing. Brief pause before the question, as if giving him time to picture it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、動物園の、絶対、シマウマ、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、孫と、絶対、見たぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I really remember going to the zoo with your grandfather and the grandchildren. We saw the zebras, didn't we, gran? That stays with me.
lines.style: Specific, grounded detail. Voice lifts slightly on the image itself—the zebras, the day. Not wistful exactly, but vivid. Checking in with her across the memory. Settles on 'stays with me' with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんの、絶対、鞭、絶対、馬を扱う時の、絶対、姿、絶対、忘れないわよ、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Long ago, I can still see your grandfather with the whip, handling the horses—the way he moved, the way he held himself. I haven't forgotten that. You remember, don't you?
lines.style: Slow, respectful. Each image comes deliberately, like painting. Breath before 'handling the horses'—the physicality matters. Voice carries weight but not heaviness. Ends with gentle certainty, not as a question but as an affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、商売の、絶対、ハンドブック、絶対、自分で、絶対、書いたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, your father wrote out a whole handbook for his business by hand. He actually did that—I watched him. You remember that, don't you, gran?
lines.style: Light wonder mixed with pride. The detail of 'by hand' lands with quiet emphasis. Pace picks up slightly—he's animated by the memory of the effort. Then settles back into the question, looking at her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、暖簾の、絶対、さらし布、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、洗濯したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Long ago, I remember washing the noren cloth, the bleached linen—that was something I did. That stays clear in my mind. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Quiet, grounded. The work itself is honored in the tone—not laborious, but tended. Soft certainty. 'Stays clear' arrives with an almost physical clarity. Closes gently, without needing reassurance, more like completing a sentence together.
